operationalization: Estimate each apical cell's growth rate, interdivision interval, pre-division shape, and wall orientation, then test whether the growth-to-division ratio predicts the stated transverse, oblique, and axial regimes.

rationale: All variables can be extracted from sufficiently long time-lapse sequences and the orientation regimes are explicit. Existing datasets permit tests in restricted taxa, but not the full cryptogam scope or a clean causal attribution.
